nodes.name: taiyi_pan_controller.dart
nodes.summary: ChangeNotifier-based controller that loads Tai Yi school configurations and orchestrates pan (chart) calculation, exposing reactive state for the UI layer.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Flutter's ChangeNotifier pattern for reactive UI binding.

nodes.name: TaiYiPanController
nodes.summary: Loads available divination schools and computes pan data for a given DateTime, school, and chart type, broadcasting state changes via ChangeNotifier.

nodes.name: deity_kind.dart
nodes.summary: Enumerates all Tai Yi deity kinds (Tai Yi, host/guest generals, the four Ji stars, six gods, etc.) plus their conceptual layers (tian/di/shen).

nodes.name: door.dart
nodes.summary: Enumerates the eight Tai Yi doors (开、休、生、伤、杜、景、死、惊) used in divination placement.

nodes.name: eight_door.dart
nodes.summary: Enumerates the eight gates (八门) with their stable IDs and single-character display names for use in chart rendering.

nodes.name: geju.dart
nodes.summary: Enumerates Tai Yi 格局 (configuration patterns) detected during pan analysis (e.g. 掩、迫、关、囚 patterns).

nodes.name: god.dart
nodes.summary: Enumerates the sixteen Tai Yi gods (太乙十六神) and 正间 (zheng/jian) classification types used to label palace positions.

nodes.name: gong.dart
nodes.summary: Enumerates the nine Tai Yi palaces (太乙九宫: 坎、坤、震、巽、中、乾、兑、艮、离) which are the spatial substrate for all chart placements.

nodes.name: gui_shen.dart
nodes.summary: Enumerates the 贵神 (noble spirits) used in Tai Yi pan analysis with their canonical IDs and display names.

nodes.name: ming_gong.dart
nodes.summary: Enumerates the twelve life palaces (十二宫: 命、财、兄弟、田宅…) and the four spirits (四神) used in Tai Yi natal chart layouts.

nodes.name: taiyi_enum_extensions.dart
nodes.summary: Provides Dart extension methods adding stable string IDs and fromId/tryFromId parsing to the core Tai Yi enums (gong, door, sixteen gods).
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Dart extensions to bolt parsing logic onto enums declared elsewhere.

nodes.name: main.dart
nodes.summary: Flutter application entry point; configures the MaterialApp theme with the Tai Yi classic color palette and Noto Serif Khitan typography, then routes to TaiYiPanPage.

nodes.name: ConstantNineGongDataClass.dart
nodes.summary: Tiny stub defining a ConstantTaiYiNineGongDataClass placeholder used by the legacy beauty_page and rectangle_pan layouts.

nodes.name: custom_deity_definition.dart
nodes.summary: Defines the data shape and repository interfaces for user-supplied custom deity algorithms, including in-memory, JSON, and DB repository placeholders.

nodes.name: CustomDeityDefinition
nodes.summary: Immutable definition of a user-supplied custom deity, including school binding, priority, algorithm spec, and JSON serialization.

nodes.name: CustomDeityAlgorithmSpec
nodes.summary: Algorithm template configuration for a custom deity (template id, version, parameters) supporting JSON serialization.

nodes.name: CustomDeityRepository
nodes.summary: Abstract repository interface for loading custom deity definitions scoped to a school.

nodes.name: InMemoryCustomDeityRepository
nodes.summary: In-memory CustomDeityRepository implementation filtering by enabled flag and schoolId; intended for tests and ephemeral configuration.

nodes.name: di_pan_model.dart
nodes.summary: Models the 地盘 (earth chart) layer of a Tai Yi reading, capturing per-palace placements with JSON serialization.

nodes.name: geju_model.dart
nodes.summary: Models the 格局 (pattern) analysis result of a Tai Yi pan with entry-level metadata including related palaces, deities, severity, and classical references.

nodes.name: GeJuResultModel
nodes.summary: Holds the list of detected geju patterns for a chart with helper lookups (has/of) and JSON serialization.

nodes.name: GeJuEntry
nodes.summary: Single geju hit record with description, related palaces/deities, severity score, and classical reference id.

nodes.name: gui_shen_model.dart
nodes.summary: Models the 贵神 (noble spirit) placements component of a Tai Yi pan with per-palace mapping.

nodes.name: ming_pan_model.dart
nodes.summary: Models the 命盘 (natal chart) layer with 命宫/身宫 anchors and the twelve life palaces — used across Jinjing, Tongzong, and Jicheng schools.

nodes.name: MingPanModel
nodes.summary: Top-level natal chart model holding 命宫, 身宫, the twelve palace placements, and method notes.

nodes.name: MingPalaceModel
nodes.summary: Single life-palace record binding a palace type to a Tai Yi gong with its resident deities and notes.

nodes.name: pan_computed_item.dart
nodes.summary: Generic computed item model representing any deity/general/eye/door placement on the pan with kind, source, priority, and metadata — the unified interchange shape for built-in and custom calculations.

nodes.name: PanComputedItem
nodes.summary: Immutable computed pan item with builder copyWith, kind/source typing, and metadata bag — used for deities, generals, eyes, doors, counts, and custom deities.

nodes.name: ren_pan_model.dart
nodes.summary: Models the 人盘 (human chart) layer of a Tai Yi reading with per-palace placements.

nodes.name: shen_pan_model.dart
nodes.summary: Models the 神盘 (spirit chart) layer including 太岁、岁破、值符 and the six gods/four spirits with palace placements, convertible to a list of DeityPlacement records.

nodes.name: ShenPanModel
nodes.summary: Spirit-chart aggregate holding 太岁/岁破/值符 anchors and twelve optional spirit placements; converts to DeityPlacement list and JSON.

nodes.name: tian_pan_model.dart
nodes.summary: Models the 天盘 (heaven chart) layer with Tai Yi, host/guest generals, the four Ji stars, five blessings, and other heaven-layer deities — the richest of the four pan layers.

nodes.name: TianPanModel
nodes.summary: Heaven-chart aggregate carrying Tai Yi and 18 deity/general palace placements plus their 入宫年数; converts to DeityPlacement list and JSON.

nodes.name: DeityPlacement
nodes.summary: Single (kind, gong) deity placement record with optional reason and metadata bag, used as the lingua franca between pan layers and rendering.

nodes.name: year_ji_model.dart
nodes.summary: Defines YearJiDataModel capturing the core annual Tai Yi (岁计) parameters — accumulated year, five-yuan局, 元/局/纪 numbers, year hexagram, and 太乙行宫 position — derived from canonical formulas documented inline.

nodes.name: YearJiDataModel
nodes.summary: Immutable container for all year-chart parameters with computed displayText and JSON serialization; the formula contract is documented in the class docstring.

nodes.name: navigator.dart
nodes.summary: Route generator with a named-routes registry (/taiyishenshu, /taiyishenshu/legacy, /taiyishenshu/demo) and an alternate slide-transition route for the primary page.

nodes.name: NavigatorGenerator
nodes.summary: Static route registry and generateRoute/generateRoute1 builders mapping named routes to page widgets, with an error fallback page.

nodes.name: beauty_page.dart
nodes.summary: Heavyweight legacy 'beauty' visualization page rendering the nine-palace board with custom painters for the 28-star outer ring and an indicator scale, plus animation controllers.
nodes.languageNotes: Stateful widget mixing TickerProviderStateMixin for multiple concurrent animations and two dedicated CustomPainter subclasses.

nodes.name: BeautyPage
nodes.summary: Stateful Flutter widget shell for the beauty-style Tai Yi pan visualization.

nodes.name: TwentyEightStarsCircle
nodes.summary: CustomPainter that draws the outer 28-mansion (二十八宿) ring around the nine-palace board.

nodes.name: IndicatorScalePainter
nodes.summary: CustomPainter rendering the indicator scale/ticks on the beauty-page board.

nodes.name: my_home_page.dart
nodes.summary: Demo home page wiring the pie-segment painter into a CircleRingPainter-based interactive chart visualization with tab/animation state.

nodes.name: MyHomePage
nodes.summary: Stateful widget shell for the demo home page taking a title parameter.

nodes.name: CircleRingPainter
nodes.summary: Large CustomPainter that draws the multi-layered circular ring chart used by the demo page.

nodes.name: rectangle_pan.dart
nodes.summary: Legacy rectangular nine-palace pan page rendering each palace with the shared tai_yi_gong_content_background widget; the older sibling of taiyi_pan_page.

nodes.name: RectanglePanel
nodes.summary: Large stateful widget rendering the full legacy rectangular nine-palace layout with hand-tuned positioning for every palace.

nodes.name: taiyi_pan_page.dart
nodes.summary: Primary Tai Yi pan page wiring TaiYiPanController, theme, info panel, and the v1/v2 pan grids; the production-facing chart interface.

nodes.name: TaiYiPanPage
nodes.summary: Stateful widget entry-point that hosts the primary Tai Yi chart interface.

nodes.name: pie_segment_painter.dart
nodes.summary: Custom Flutter painter that renders a single pie-chart segment with configurable fill, border, and arc geometry. Used by chart widgets to compose deity/palace ring visualizations.
nodes.languageNotes: Flutter CustomPainter subclass implementing paint() and shouldRepaint().

nodes.name: PieSegmentPainter
nodes.summary: CustomPainter that draws a filled arc segment with an optional stroked border, parameterized by start/sweep angles and colors.

nodes.name: algorithm_engine.dart
nodes.summary: Generic deity placement engine that dispatches algorithm specs (fixed position, stepped cycle, relative offset, branch walker, cumulative walk, custom formula) to compute palace placements from a CalculationContext.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Dart switch expressions for dispatch and structured DeityPlacementResult for outputs.

nodes.name: DeityAlgorithmEngine
nodes.summary: Strategy-pattern engine that executes one of six algorithm types against a calculation context and resolves deity-to-palace placements, with helpers for palace sequence walking and gong/branch resolution.

nodes.name: algorithm_enums.dart
nodes.summary: Defines enums describing algorithm categories (algorithm type, palace system, dun variant) used by deity placement specifications.

nodes.name: algorithm_spec.dart
nodes.summary: Value-object classes describing the parameters of a deity placement algorithm: palace step, cycle step, dun variant config, and stepped-cycle parameters.

nodes.name: PalaceStep
nodes.summary: Immutable record describing a single step in a palace walk sequence with optional skip behavior.

nodes.name: CycleStep
nodes.summary: Parameters for one layer of a stepped cycle (cycle length, step size, label) used in multi-tier divisor calculations.

nodes.name: DunVariantConfig
nodes.summary: Configures yang-dun vs yin-dun palace sequence variants for direction-sensitive algorithms.

nodes.name: SteppedCycleParams
nodes.summary: Parameter bundle for the stepped-cycle algorithm: cycle layers, palace system, dun variant, and seed value mapping.

nodes.name: calculation_context.dart
nodes.summary: Carries the accumulated sequence value, chart type, dun type, and prior placements into the algorithm engine; also defines DeityPlacementResult and StepResult output shapes.

nodes.name: CalculationContext
nodes.summary: Input context bundle (sequence value, chart type, dun type, prior placements) provided to each algorithm spec evaluation.

nodes.name: DeityPlacementResult
nodes.summary: Output record of a deity placement: the resolved palace, intermediate step results, and any computed metadata.

nodes.name: StepResult
nodes.summary: Per-layer quotient/remainder record for stepped-cycle algorithm traces, useful for debugging and explanation.

nodes.name: deity_definition.dart
nodes.summary: Defines DeityDefinition and DeityAlgorithmSpec records that link a deity (by kind and name) to its placement algorithm parameters.

nodes.name: DeityAlgorithmSpec
nodes.summary: Type-erased spec wrapper that pairs an AlgorithmType discriminator with its parameter object.

nodes.name: DeityDefinition
nodes.summary: Per-deity metadata bundle (kind, name, algorithm spec) loaded from external JSON repositories to drive placement.

nodes.name: expression_parser.dart
nodes.summary: Tiny arithmetic expression parser used to evaluate deity offset formulas from JSON definitions; supports integer arithmetic with variable substitution.

nodes.name: ExpressionParser
nodes.summary: Recursive-descent expression evaluator returning integers for simple arithmetic on named variables, used by algorithm spec params.

nodes.name: school_config.dart
nodes.summary: School-specific configuration carrying epoch year, cycle length, and palace-system defaults for one Tai Yi school (Jinjing/Tongzong/Jicheng).

nodes.name: TaiYiSchool
nodes.summary: Aggregate config for one Tai Yi school: identifier, label, epoch settings, and palace defaults.

nodes.name: school_repository.dart
nodes.summary: Abstract repository interface for loading school configs and deity definitions; implemented by JSON-backed providers.

nodes.name: official_json_repository.dart
nodes.summary: Concrete SchoolRepository implementation that loads official Tai Yi school configs and deity definitions from bundled JSON assets.

nodes.name: OfficialJsonSchoolRepository
nodes.summary: Loads and caches Tai Yi school configs and deity definitions from JSON files shipped with the app.

nodes.name: pan_data_model.dart
nodes.summary: Aggregate data models describing the rendered Tai Yi chart: input parameters, palace data, host/guest statistics, classic references, and the top-level PanDataModel.

nodes.name: PanInputModel
nodes.summary: User-supplied chart inputs (date, school, chart type) feeding the calculator.

nodes.name: PalaceDataModel
nodes.summary: Per-palace bundle of deity placements (zheng/ji/men/sheng) used to render one of the nine gong cells.

nodes.name: HostGuestDataModel

tour.title: 项目概览：传承与现代架构的交汇
tour.description: 太乙神数（Tai Yi Shen Shu）是中国传统三式之一。本项目通过现代化的 Flutter 架构实现了金镜、统宗、集成三大流派的排盘推算。本步骤将带你浏览 README，了解项目的核心目标、技术栈以及开发规范。

tour.title: 业务需求与算法路线图
tour.description: 在深入代码之前，理解业务逻辑至关重要。PRD 详细描述了流派差异和排盘需求，而 Plans 则展示了如何将这些复杂的玄学算法拆解为可实现的开发阶段。这里不仅是文档，更是系统的逻辑基石。

tour.title: 领域语言：太乙神数的数字化定义
tour.description: 太乙神数拥有一套独特的术语体系。我们通过 Dart 枚举精确定义了‘九宫’、‘八门’和‘十六神’等核心概念。taiyi_enum_extensions 为这些枚举提供了 ID 解析和序列化支持，是数据持久化的基础。
tour.languageLesson: 使用 Dart 的 Extension 模式，在不修改原始枚举定义的情况下，通过扩展方法注入 ID 解析逻辑，体现了‘开闭原则’。

tour.title: 核心引擎：策略模式驱动的排盘算法
tour.description: DeityAlgorithmEngine 是整个项目的灵魂。它采用了策略模式，能够根据配置调度‘固定位置’、‘步进循环’或‘自定义公式’等多种算法。这种设计让它能灵活应对不同神煞的千变万化的运行规则。
tour.languageLesson: 利用 Dart 的模式匹配（Switch Expressions）实现高效的算法调度。注意算法引擎是如何将复杂的步进规则解构为通用的计算步骤的。

tour.title: 数据驱动：神煞与流派的 JSON 定义
tour.description: 我们不硬编码算法。所有的神煞（Deities）和流派（Schools）都通过 JSON 定义。这种‘数据驱动’的设计允许我们在不修改核心代码的情况下，快速修复某个流派的特定偏差或新增神煞。

tour.title: 统筹指挥：太乙排盘计算器
tour.description: TaiYiPanCalculator 是排盘流程的控制中心。它负责计算‘积年’、‘岁计’，并根据选定的流派和日期，指挥引擎计算所有神煞的最终落宫。它是算法引擎与外部业务逻辑的聚合点。

tour.title: 状态管理：连接计算与 UI 的桥梁
tour.description: TaiYiPanController 承担了控制器的职责。它负责异步加载配置、触发计算，并使用 Flutter 的 ChangeNotifier 机制将最新的排盘状态分发给 UI 层，确保界面的实时更新。
tour.languageLesson: ChangeNotifier 是 Flutter 官方推荐的轻量级状态管理方案。结合监听者模式，它能高效地驱动 UI 层的局部刷新。

tour.title: 核心 UI：九宫格排盘视图
tour.description: 九宫格（NineGongGrid）是太乙神数最直观的展示形式。它将计算出的神煞位置映射到特定的宫位视图中。通过 TaiYiPanPainter 绘制复杂的线条和布局，实现了兼具传统美感与现代交互的推算界面。
tour.languageLesson: CustomPainter 允许我们在 Canvas 上直接绘图。在太乙排盘中，我们需要根据计算出的几何坐标精确绘制连接神煞的连线。

tour.title: 应用入口与主题配置
tour.description: 最后，我们来看 main.dart 和主题配置。项目为太乙神数定制了一套‘经典风’视觉方案，包括特定配色的材质调色板。NavigatorGenerator 则定义了应用的导航树，将用户引导至核心排盘页面。

tour.title: 质量保证：算法的冒烟测试
tour.description: 对于推算类应用，准确性就是生命。通过冒烟测试和元数据校验，我们能确保在重构或更新算法定义后，核心计算逻辑依然保持正确。这是我们在复杂逻辑中稳步前进的信心来源。
